moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio counter-rotate, written here): Outer ring (8 dots on r 62 px, one larger marker) rotates 0 → +360° while the inner square (50 px) rotates 0 → −360°, both 1000 ms sine.inOut about one fixed centre; site loop 2000 ms (1 s rest). Params: duration (1 s) · outer (+360°) · inner (−360°) · ease (sine.inOut).
